player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Nim.
Your goal is to take the last remaining object.
On each turn, choose exactly one pile and remove one or more objects from it.
Use the format '[pile quantity]', where pile is the pile index and quantity is the number of objects to remove.
For example, '[0 3]' removes 3 objects from pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: No valid move format found. Use '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Mchezaji {player_id}, Hatua batili. Safu {col} imepita kikomo.
invalid_move.non_positive: No nginya vethĩwe ve kĩndũ o na kĩmwe kĩ nthĩnĩ wakyo.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Haiwezi kuondoa {quantity} kutoka kwenye mfuko {pile_index} (zimebaki {pile_count} pekee).

observation.removed_from_piles: Mchezaji {player_id} alicheza [{pile_index} {quantity}], akiondoa {quantity} kitu (vi) kutoka kundi {pile_index}.

outcome.win: Mũthaũki {player_id} eeta kĩndũ kĩla kya mũthya!
